Use knowitcz/copilot-agentic-demo as the repository. Create a new GitHub issue. Human might not be precise, so ask follow-up questions which you find necessary to create a good issue. There will be refinement steps after the issue is created, so it's better to create a more high-level issue if the details are not clear.
